note: The Godthrone kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). Keys are the kit's MAT slots (50-biome-godthrone-species.js, BIO.libSwap) and the host's ground slots (84-host-ground.js: KGROUND.layer and hostGroundLib). Station 1 (the summit vent, 2026-10-26): the halo's beads are KGROUND's sand kind over ground.beads.orange (the Moon's orange soil) and ground.sand.black (the crystallised beads), full colour; the pit's glassy floor ground.obsidian and the spatter ground.scoria, full colour; groundDetail a grey multiply (ground.cinder); rockFace the basalt's grain on every face, grey under KSTRATA's tibasalt colours (rock.basalt.flowbanded: THE TITANIUM BASALT IS A TINT, a stand-in the plan's section 8 allows; core/materials/PROMPTS-NEEDED.md section 20 has the optional prompt for its own set); rock the talus blocks and stones (the same grain, grey under the instance's near-black); bomb the bombs' and the spatter's glass skin (ground.lava.crust, grey); lavaCrust the throat's crust grain (fx/lava's crust); hair Pele's hair (card.pele.hair, a 3x3 sheet: one mat a card, the middle cell); portal the sealed portal's white render (concrete.ancient). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/godthrone after any change, then python3 build.py.
